title: Guest Chat admission refuses the supported ARM64 hosted runner
surface: Guarded hosted guest Chat dispatch planner
organization_context: No account token, profile or organization
preconditions: The exact v0.2.533 release artifact is available from run 39098498144.
The hosted acceptance workflow supports both macos-15-intel and macos-15, each with its own fresh resource admission.
reproduction: Plan a B-lane guest-chat dispatch for the v0.2.533 release with runner_label=macos-15.
The original planner rejects it with HOSTED_CHAT_RUNNER_REFUSED before dispatch, even though the workflow accepts that exact label.
Hosted Intel attempts 39096823813 and 39099012761 independently reached real Chat but ended resourceInvalid=true with RESOURCE_CPU_CONFIRMATION_EXPIRED. Neither is a resource-valid product pass.
expected: The normal admission path accepts only the two reviewed standard macOS labels, forwards the selected label, and preserves release provenance, lane capacity, workflow-byte and source-drift checks before dispatch.
actual: The planner previously required and sent macos-15-intel. It blocked the supported ARM64 comparison after repeated Intel CPU confirmation expiry.
reproducibility: The focused planner and CLI tests failed with HOSTED_CHAT_RUNNER_REFUSED before the repair and pass after it; the two Intel resource verdicts remain immutable.
severity: S2: guarded current-candidate guest Chat comparison blocked on the supported alternate runner.
priority: P1: admit one exact-artifact ARM64 comparison while preserving all resource thresholds.
cause: planHostedGuestChat checked for Intel only and serialized runner_label=macos-15-intel instead of the validated selected label.
sibling_census: The guest Chat route alone is changed. The hosted workflow already permits and architecture-checks macos-15; other admission routes retain their existing runner contracts.
reviewer: Independent peer verdicts A PASS and B PASS on exact v0.2.533 non-live admission proof; native ARM64 comparison pending.
acceptance_criteria: Exact macos-15 and macos-15-intel labels produce matching dispatch inputs; omission defaults to Intel.
Unsupported labels and changed product-driver bytes are refused before any dispatch.
A fresh guarded ARM64 run produces a completed valid resource journal and independently reviewed native guest Chat evidence before current-candidate product credit.

verification.red: Focused test failed on the original planner and CLI with HOSTED_CHAT_RUNNER_REFUSED for macos-15.
verification.focused: Three focused tests pass; one opt-in live proof is skipped. Biome check and workflow cost guard pass.
verification.peer: Independent peer A PASS and B PASS after v0.2.533 fixture and source-drift check.
verification.native: Pending one guarded ARM64 comparison; no heavy run was dispatched in this repair lane.

limitations: The source repair permits a new measurement; it does not change CPU, load, watchdog or confirmation thresholds.
The earlier Intel Chat report and screenshots cannot override an invalid resource verdict.
next_action: Release owner uses the normal guarded admission path for one serial macos-15 run of the exact v0.2.533 artifact, checks completed resource journals and native report, then seeks independent live review.
